tools.name: list_profiles

tools.name: claim_preview
tools.description: Make a profile from preview_profile your own Flux dashboard. Requires sign-in; creates your own_profile stream on the free plan pointing at the same posts. Refuses if you already track that profile.

tools.description: Get engagement time series for a profile with gap-filled buckets, rolling averages, and trend direction. tools.description: Return the authenticated user's current credit balance, this period's monthly allocation, and credits used since the period started. Free.

tools.name: get_usage_history
tools.description: Return recent credit_ledger transactions for the authenticated user. Filter by tool name, reason, or date range. Paginated. Free.

tools.name: get_cost_estimate

tools.name: create_stream
tools.description: Create a new research stream (external profile, company, topic, person interests, hiring signals, or ad watch). Running the stream on its schedule costs credits (see get_cost_estimate for the per-type cost). own_profile streams are not created here — they come from subscription checkout.

tools.name: list_streams
tools.description: List all research streams for the authenticated user (external profiles, companies, topics, person interests, hiring signals, ad watches, and own_profile). Pass `type` to filter. Replaces list_profiles for the streams-first world, but list_profiles continues to work for V1-compatible callers.

tools.name: get_stream_feed
tools.description: Return the most recent posts a stream has collected into the library, newest first by published_at. Use this to browse what a topic / external profile / person_interests / company stream has surfaced on its schedule.

tools.name: pause_stream
tools.description: Pause a stream so it stops running on its cron schedule. Existing posts remain in the library. Use resume_stream to re-enable it. own_profile streams are billing-managed and cannot be paused here.

tools.name: resume_stream
tools.description: Resume a paused stream. Sets active=true and queues it to run on the next cron tick by clearing next_run_at. own_profile streams are billing-managed and cannot be resumed here.

tools.name: delete_stream
tools.description: Delete a stream and its stream_runs. Posts collected by the stream stay in your library (stream_id is set to NULL via ON DELETE SET NULL) so historical data isn't lost. tools.name: run_stream_now
tools.description: Trigger an immediate run of an active stream, bypassing its schedule. The run is fire-and-forget — the response confirms the dispatch but post collection happens asynchronously. tools.name: linkedin_profile_info
tools.description: Fetch a LinkedIn person profile (headline, current role, work history, education, location). Costs 5 credits per call. Results are upserted into `people` (structured fields) and `linkedin_profiles` (so profile-brief renders) — same enrichment side-effect as the other linkedin_profile_* tools.

tools.name: linkedin_profile_posts
tools.description: Fetch recent posts from a LinkedIn person profile. 5 credits per page of 50, up to 250 posts, charged only for pages actually fetched. Results are stored in the post library (source_type='external') and linked to a linkedin_profiles row so profile-brief can render research-only prospects.

tools.name: linkedin_company_posts
tools.description: Fetch recent posts from a LinkedIn company page. 5 credits per page of 50, up to 250 posts, charged only for pages actually fetched. Results are stored in the post library (source_type='external') and linked to a linkedin_profiles row (profile_type='company').

tools.name: linkedin_post_search
tools.description: Search LinkedIn posts by keyword. Costs 5 credits per call. Returns a single page of matching posts.

tools.name: linkedin_profile_reactions
tools.description: Fetch the recent posts a LinkedIn person has reacted to. Useful for inferring interests. Costs 5 credits per call.

tools.name: linkedin_profile_comments
tools.description: Fetch the recent posts a LinkedIn person has commented on. Useful for inferring interests and conversation partners. Costs 5 credits per call.

tools.name: linkedin_job_search
tools.description: Search LinkedIn job postings. Useful for tracking hiring signals at target companies. Costs 5 credits per call.

tools.name: linkedin_ad_search
tools.description: Search the LinkedIn ad library. Useful for tracking competitor ad creative and messaging. Costs 10 credits per call.

tools.name: linkedin_people_search
tools.description: Search LinkedIn people. Filter by company, title, location, or free-text keywords. Costs 5 credits per call. Returns a single page of matching profiles.

tools.name: linkedin_company_search
tools.description: Search LinkedIn companies. Filter by keywords, industryId, or location. Costs 5 credits per call. Returns a single page of matching companies.

tools.name: linkedin_post_reactions
tools.description: Fetch the people who reacted to a single LinkedIn post. Costs 5 credits per call. Engagers (with reaction kind) are persisted to the post_engagements graph so subsequent queries about who-engages-with-whom are SQL, not API calls.

tools.name: linkedin_post_comments
tools.description: Fetch the people who commented on a single LinkedIn post (and their comment text). Costs 5 credits per call. Each comment is persisted to post_engagements with the commenter and full comment text.

tools.name: find_similar_posts
tools.description: Find persisted posts whose embeddings are nearest to a free-text query — pgvector cosine over the local post library, no LinkedIn pull, free. tools.name: score_draft
tools.description: Predict how a draft post will perform against the user's historical data. tools.name: suggest_angles
tools.description: Given a topic, suggest distinct content angles informed by what performs well in the user's scoped data. tools.name: list_segments

tools.name: create_segment
tools.description: Create a new audience segment (named group of people) for the authenticated user. tools.name: add_to_segment
tools.description: Add one or more people (by person_id) to an audience segment. Existing members are silently ignored. Free — costs 0 credits.

tools.name: remove_from_segment
tools.description: Remove one or more people (by person_id) from an audience segment. Missing members are silently ignored. Free — costs 0 credits.

tools.name: resolve_segment
tools.description: Resolve an audience segment into a concrete list of person_ids. For manual / auto_stream segments, returns stored members. For smart segments, evaluates the segment's `config` predicate against the people table and returns matches. Free — costs 0 credits.

tools.name: list_segment_templates
tools.description: List available smart-segment templates. Pass a template id to create_segment to pre-fill its `config` predicate without crafting one from scratch. Free — costs 0 credits.

tools.name: get_alerts
tools.description: Return recent alerts for the authenticated user's streams. An alert is emitted whenever a scheduled stream run surfaces new items. Pass `unread_only=true` to skip alerts the user has already marked read. Free — costs 0 credits.

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Create a new post collection for the authenticated user. Set type='manual' to hand-curate posts with add_to_collection, or type='smart' with a `config` predicate (e.g. {format:'video',min_likes:50}) to define a dynamic collection resolved on-demand by resolve_collection. Free — costs 0 credits.

tools.name: add_to_collection
tools.description: Pin one or more posts (by post_id) into a collection you own — works on any collection type. tools.name: remove_from_collection
tools.description: Remove one or more posts (by post_id) from a collection. Missing members are silently ignored. Free — costs 0 credits.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List all post collections for the authenticated user, with member counts. Includes manual collections, smart collections (predicate-based), and auto_stream collections (system-managed). Free — costs 0 credits.

tools.name: resolve_collection
tools.description: Resolve a post collection into a concrete list of post_ids. For manual / auto_stream collections, returns stored members. For smart collections, evaluates the collection's `config` predicate against the user's posts and returns matches. Free — costs 0 credits.
